Lazy Exceptions were being raised every time a non initialized lazy collection was being transformed from Java object to Json string by Jersey  framework.

According to the system architecture rules, when a collection is needed it must be explicitly fetched before leaving the transaction, if not, it will be set to null by a Jersey response filter.
